label: B25-JTAG-UART
title: Close polling JTAG-UART DATA/CONTROL and RX/TX semantics
forbidden_regions: top-level clock and BRAM parameter regions owned by T-038/T-039
shared SoC integration TB/test registry, interrupts/GIC, QEMU and board actions

protocol.data_read: RVALID bit15; character bits7:0; read pops RX FIFO
protocol.control_read: WSPACE bits31:16; AC is not TX capacity
protocol.response: accepted request completes once and response remains stable until rsp_ready

scope: Test the existing classic addr[2] mapping first, fix only proven bridge defects, and model RX injection/TX full/waitrequest/reset without importing the RISC-V high-bit workaround.
validation: Directed SV covers DATA versus CONTROL, delayed waitrequest, RX pop, TX full/retry, held response, reset/valid drop, repeated characters and no duplicate Avalon side effect.
acceptance: Core-visible +0/+4 accesses remain distinct through the bridge, PING/PONG primitives can be driven in simulation, and no IRQ dependency is introduced.
resource: No heavy or remote job in the lane; parent owns full SoC validation.

result.status: accepted; Icarus/Verilator focused and parent SoC exactly-once interaction checks pass
